refus.spectrum_busy: A spectrum setting is already in progress: try again.
refus.spectrum_timeout: The radio did not confirm the spectrum setting.
refus.spectrum_refused: The radio refused this spectrum setting (in fixed mode, the span cannot be set).
refus.out_of_band: Frequency outside the allowed transmit bands.
refus.split_unreadable: Split unreadable on the radio: transmission refused for safety (the transmit frequency is unknown).
refus.xit_unreadable: ΔTX (XIT) unreadable on the radio: transmission refused for safety (the transmit frequency is unknown).
refus.cooldown: Too soon: wait a second before transmitting again.
refus.unknown_client: Client not recognised by the gateway.
refus.tx_disabled: No transmit band allowed in the configuration.
refus.cat_error: The radio is not responding properly.
refus.ptt_unreadable: The PTT state cannot be read on this radio: transmission refused for safety.
refus.local_active: Radio in use on site (microphone, button or mode of the radio): remote PTT blocked. Use « Take control » to unblock it.
refus.local_tx: The radio is transmitting from its own microphone right now: you cannot take control.
refus.rig_hot: Radio too hot: transmission refused until it cools down.
refus.audio_missing: Sound card of the radio missing (radio unplugged or off?): transmission refused. The station will find it again by itself.
refus.power_disabled: Remote power on and off is disabled on this station (openRemoteTRX Console, menu 2.8).
refus.power_unsupported: This radio cannot be switched on or off through CAT.
refus.power_busy: The radio is being switched on or off: wait a few seconds.
refus.rig_off: Radio switched off: switch it back on (new connection) before adjusting it or transmitting.
refus.rig_on: The radio is not switched off: nothing to switch on.
refus.power_off_failed: The radio refused the power-off command.
refus.report_too_soon: A report has just been sent: try again in a few seconds.
refus.report_storage_error: The station could not save the report (disk?).
refus.reports_unavailable: This station does not receive reports: use « Share / e-mail ».
refus.fault_latched: Latched fault: action on the station required.
refus.starting: The station is starting: try again in a moment.
refus.not_idle: A cut-off or a transmission is in progress.
refus.cancelled: Transmit request cancelled by a cut-off.
refus.ptt_write_failed: The transmit command failed; back to receive.
refus.rig_did_not_key: The radio did not go into transmit; back to receive.
refus.tx_active: Not possible while transmitting (frequency, mode and radio settings are locked).
refus.mode_not_allowed: Transmission refused in this mode: the radio only modulates from USB audio in data mode (USB-D...). Change the mode.
refus.unknown_memory: This memory no longer exists (deleted from another device?).
refus.memories_unavailable: Memories are not available on this station.
refus.storage_error: The station could not save the memories (disk?).
refus.layouts_unavailable: Custom layouts are not available on this station.
refus.beeps_unavailable: End-of-transmission beeps are not available on this station.
refus.selcall_unavailable: SELCALL is not enabled on this station ([selcall] enabled = true in station.toml).
refus.selcall_not_armed: First arm SELCALL on a code: the call transmits the armed code.
refus.selcall_too_long: SELCALL call longer than the maximum transmit time (TOT): reduce manual_repeat on the station.
refus.beeps_storage_error: The station could not save the beep setting.
refus.layout_invalid: Layout refused by the station (safety or readability rules not met).
refus.layout_storage_error: The station could not save the layout (disk?).
refus.forbidden: Listener account: receive only, no command to the station.
refus.unknown_listener: This listener is no longer connected.
refus.still_overloaded: The station is not back to normal yet: listening for listeners stays suspended.
refus.listeners_off: Listening for listeners is closed on the station (openRemoteTRX Console, menu 4.2: maximum number of listeners).
refus.listeners_unavailable: This station does not handle listeners.
refus.voice_profiles_unavailable: This station does not store equalizer profiles.
refus.friends_unavailable: Group presence unavailable on this station (« presence » module stopped or disabled).
refus.sdr_unavailable: SDR unavailable on this station (« sdr » module stopped or disabled).
refus.sdr_invalid: SDR setting refused (value out of range).
refus.sdr_error: The SDR module could not handle the request.
refus.sdr_audio_unavailable: SDR sound unavailable on this connection (reload the page).
refus.friends_error: Group presence could not handle the request.
refus.monitoring_unavailable: Monitoring unavailable on this station (« monlink » module stopped or disabled).
refus.monitoring_error: Monitoring could not handle the request.
refus.diffusion_unavailable: Broadcasting unavailable on this station (« diffusion » module stopped or disabled).
refus.diffusion_error: Broadcasting could not handle the request.
refus.diffusion_busy: A broadcast is already running: stop it first.
refus.diffusion_no_secrets: Broadcast secrets missing or unreadable (server, source password, key): set up the feature.
refus.diffusion_confirm_required: Liability warning to confirm before the first broadcast.
refus.diffusion_malformed: Broadcast setting refused (duration, text or password).
refus.diffusion_unknown_action: Broadcast action unknown to the station (update needed?).
refus.voice_profiles_storage_error: Equalizer profile not saved on the station (disk?).
refus.voice_profile_refused: Equalizer profile refused by the station.
refus.swr_busy: SWR measurement in progress: STOP to end it.
refus.swr_unavailable: SWR measurement unavailable on this station.
refus.breizh_unavailable: Breizh Audio Box is not used by this station.
refus.breizh_storage_error: Breizh setting not saved on the station (disk?).
refus.freedv_unavailable: FreeDV is not enabled on this station.
refus.freedv_tx: Transmitting: the FreeDV mode can only be changed while receiving.
refus.freedv_missing: FreeDV decoder not found on the station (see [freedv] in station.toml).
refus.freedv_storage_error: FreeDV working folder not accessible on the station.
refus.netprobe_unavailable: Network quality probe missing from this station.
refus.netprobe_error: Network quality probe: error on the station (see its log).
refus.swr_no_fm_mode: No FM mode allowed for the SWR measurement (add FM-D to the station's transmit modes).
refus.swr_out_of_band: No measurement point within the station's allowed bands.
refus.swr_bad_range: Impossible measurement range (at least 2 points, high frequency above low frequency).
refus.swr_too_many_points: Too many points for the SWR measurement.
refus.swr_unreadable: Radio settings not read back: SWR measurement stopped.
coupure.power_on_tx: radio switched on while transmitting: set back to receive
coupure.selcall_timeout: SELCALL call too long: cut off
coupure.mode_changed: mode changed on the radio during transmission
coupure.split_changed: split changed on the radio during transmission
coupure.xit_changed: ΔTX (XIT) changed on the radio during transmission
coupure.rig_reported_rx: the radio went back to receive
coupure.audio_lost: sound card of the radio lost
acces.account_disabled: This account is disabled on the station.
acces.account_changed: Account changed on the station: log in again.
acces.listeners_off: Listening for listeners is not open on this station.
acces.operators_full: The station is busy (too many connections).
acces.operator_absent: The operator is not connected to the station: listeners can only listen while the operator is there.
acces.too_many_forbidden: Too many refused commands: connection closed.
acces.station_overload: Station overloaded: listening for listeners suspended to protect the station.
acces.listeners_closed: The operator has closed listening for listeners.
station.power_port_missing: port {what} {port} missing: radio unplugged or USB cable?
station.power_port_unchecked: port identity not recorded: redo the setup in menu 2.8 of openRemoteTRX Console
station.power_port_identity: USB identity of the port {what} unreadable in station.toml: menu 2.8 of openRemoteTRX Console
station.power_port_moved: the radio is now on {ports} (station.toml says {port}): redo menu 2.5 of openRemoteTRX Console on the station
station.power_port_mismatch: port {port} is no longer the one {what} ({seen} instead of {expected}): redo menu 2.5 of openRemoteTRX Console on the station
station.power_cat_down: no link with rigctld: the station cannot reach the radio
station.power_rig_silent: the radio does not answer ({error}): USB cable, power supply, rear switch
station.power_no_answer: no answer from rigctld ({error}): waiting for the radio anyway
station.power_on_timeout: the radio did not switch on within {seconds} s
station.power_on_tx: the radio switched on TRANSMITTING: put back to receive; check the PTT line (RTS / DTR)
station.breizh_reactivated: Breizh resumed at the operator's request
station.breizh_reactivated_joined: Breizh resumed at the operator's request: {detail}
station.breizh_back_manual: resumed only at the operator's request
station.breizh_refusal_cat_on: Breizh has not turned off its CAT
station.breizh_refusal_latency: processing announced by Breizh too long (> 50 ms)
station.breizh_refusal_mode_off: OpenRemoteTRX mode not enabled in Breizh
station.breizh_refusal_busy: Breizh is already serving another station
station.breizh_idle_lost: Breizh has not answered for {seconds} s: next transmissions direct
station.breizh_unreachable: Breizh unreachable when sending the audio
station.breizh_fallback: Breizh has not answered for {ms} ms: rest of the transmission direct, gain {gain} dB
station.breizh_bypass_on: « Direct » chosen by {client} (from the next transmission)
station.breizh_bypass_off: « Direct » left by {client} (from the next transmission)
station.freedv_sequence: median SNR {snr} dB, sync {sync} %, {losses} sync loss(es)
station.freedv_reporter_error: FreeDV Reporter unreachable ({error}); new attempt in {seconds} s
station.overload_auto: Station overloaded ({cause}): visitor listening suspended to protect the station. Reopens automatically after 5 minutes of normal operation.
station.overload_locked: Station overloaded ({cause}): visitor listening suspended to protect the station. Too many cuts in one hour: the operator must reopen it.
refus.tx_side_unreadable: Transmit side of the radio (MAIN or SUB) unreadable: transmission refused for safety (the transmit frequency is unknown).
coupure.tx_side_changed: transmit side (MAIN / SUB) or its frequency changed on the radio during transmission
refus.cw_unavailable: CW keying is not available on this station.
refus.cw_busy: CW keying is already armed by another operator.
refus.cw_mode: CW keying refused: set the radio to the mode required by the station (data mode, e.g. PKTUSB).
refus.cw_carrier_changed: Frequency or mode changed while arming: arm CW again.
coupure.cw_lease_expired: link too slow for CW (lease expired)
coupure.cw_carrier_changed: frequency or mode changed while arming CW
coupure.cw_hang: CW pause: transmission released, resumed at the next key press
coupure.cw_retake_refused: CW transmission not resumed after a pause (refused by the station)
